name: Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe
subtitle: Silky pecorino pasta with toasted black pepper
description: A simple Roman-style pasta combining sharp Pecorino Romano, black pepper, and starchy pasta water into a smooth sauce.

ingredients.item: grated Pecorino Romano plus extra to serve
black pepper plus extra for scattering

instructions.text: Grate the Pecorino Romano if needed and set it aside.
Toast the black pepper in a large dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti in boiling water until al dente. Reserve some cooking water, then drain.
Add a little reserved pasta water to the Pecorino Romano and stir until smooth.
Add the drained spaghetti and cheese mixture to the skillet with the pepper. Toss, adding reserved pasta water as needed, until glossy and well coated.
Serve immediately with extra Pecorino Romano and black pepper scattered over the top.
